# `compat/surface/engine-texture-surface.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/surface/engine-texture-surface.js`

Adapter for a host-compositor-owned engine texture surface. The kernel supplies `gpu.createTextureSurface()` because only the host may bind the shared physical device and compositor. The compatibility guest sees this lifecycle adapter, never the raw device.

## Classes

### `class EngineTextureSurface`

Adapter for a host-compositor-owned engine texture surface. The kernel supplies `gpu.createTextureSurface()` because only the host may bind the shared physical device and compositor. The compatibility guest sees this lifecycle adapter, never the raw device.
